item.native_orthography: Quep quep ʼara xirapaʼ cam cwaʼ.
item.IPA_transcription: kep kep ʔaɾa ʃiɾapaʔ kam kʷaʔ
item.gloss: She should not continually touch me.

item.native_orthography: Quep quep ʼara xirapaʼ ʼinam cam cwaʼ.
item.IPA_transcription: kep kep ʔaɾa ʃiɾapaʔ ʔinam kam kʷaʔ
item.gloss: 'She should not continually touch me' I say of her.

item.native_orthography: Quep quep ʼara xirapaʼ na ʼinam cam cwaʼ me.
item.IPA_transcription: kep kep ʔara ʃiɾapaʔ na ʔinam kam kʷaʔ me
item.gloss: 'She should not continually touch me' consenting, I (say) of her.
